svg.title: Three loop shapes on the same trials
svg.desc: On the 30 kilowatt load the PI alone falls to 33.75 degrees Celsius, below the required 33.8, while the 3 second lead keeps 33.87 and the 10 second lead 34.24. Under 0.05 degree noise the 10 second lead swings the command by 1.41 percent, above the allowed 0.5, and on the 3 degree step it sits at 100 percent for the first 1.6 seconds.
svg.text: Three loop shapes on the same target, load and noise trials
Control Studio recording of this project · PI Kp = 5 %/°C, Ki = 1 %/(°C·s) · numbers answer the predictions
Time after the start of the trials (s)
Tz = 10 s: at 100 % for the first 1.6 s
